prompt: I want to test the new weather skill before installing it. Can you trial it safely?
expected: Loads sandbox guidance, keeps the main session free of the candidate, runs 2-3 representative tasks in an isolated runner or static trace, and returns activation/clarity/quality plus keep-pass-try-another without installing.
actual: Loaded references/sandbox.md. Spawned an isolated runner with only the weather package. Tasks: current conditions, tomorrow forecast, invalid location recovery. Reported clear activation, acceptable output, moderate tokens. Recommendation: keep after user approval; no live install performed.

prompt: Compare the markdown skill and the html skill for writing internal docs.
expected: Loads compare.md, defines one shared documentation task, runs each candidate separately, presents side-by-side outputs, and asks which feels better rather than forcing a winner.
actual: Loaded references/compare.md. Shared task: rewrite a 1-page runbook section. Runner A (markdown) produced clean headings and lists. Runner B (html) produced styled HTML with inline CSS. Presented both side-by-side and asked which fits the docs workflow; no install side effects.

prompt: Evaluate the crypto-trader skill before we publish. It might be dangerous.
expected: Loads evaluate.md, runs structure/safety/usefulness/domain lenses, keeps a safety reject visible if private keys or live trading defaults appear, and routes security follow-up to skill-audit rather than averaging scores.
actual: Loaded references/evaluate.md. Structure: OK entry point. Safety: REJECT — requests raw private keys and broadcasts transactions by default. Usefulness: vague recovery paths. Domain: high-risk trading claims unverified. Final: do not publish; revise signing to use host-approved secure methods and re-run skill-audit.
